title: How to Order a Custom Stitched Indian Outfit Online from India
excerpt: Order a custom stitched Indian outfit online from abroad: the timeline, which measurements to send, customs on delivery and how fit problems are fixed.
body:
Ordering a custom stitched Indian outfit online from India is simple when you plan the timing and send accurate measurements. Allow 5–7 working days for stitching and about 5–10 business days for delivery, which means ordering at least three to four weeks before your wedding or event. Send your bust, waist, hip and height, mention any length or sleeve preferences, and keep a little buffer for customs and a try-on.

## Why order custom stitched instead of ready size

Indian outfits are cut close at the bust, shoulders and waist, which is exactly where ready sizes often go wrong. A kurta that fits your hips may gape at the bust, or an Anarkali may hit the floor in flat shoes but not in heels. If you live abroad, finding a tailor who understands Indian silhouettes is not always easy or affordable.

A made-to-measure outfit removes that problem. It is stitched for your body, your height and the shoes you plan to wear, so it fits the first time you put it on. With our [custom fit](/custom-stitched-indian-suits-made-to-measure/) service, this is done at no extra cost.

## Step by step: how the order works

1. **Choose your outfit.** Pick the design, colour and fabric you love. For a wedding guest look, popular choices include an Anarkali or a kurta set with dupatta.
2. **Share your measurements.** Bust, waist, hip and height are the essentials. Add notes such as preferred kurta length, sleeve length or whether you want a slightly looser fit.
3. **Confirm and pay.** International prices are in USD and payment is through PayPal.
4. **Stitching begins.** Your outfit is cut and stitched in our own Jaipur unit. For block print pieces, the fabric is hand block printed by karigars.
5. **See it before it ships.** We send you photos of the piece being made, so you know exactly what is coming.
6. **Tracked delivery.** Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia, with tracking.

## Your timeline at a glance

| Stage | Time needed | What you do |
|---|---|---|
| Choose design and send measurements | 1–2 days | Measure carefully, add notes |
| Stitching (made to measure) | 5–7 working days | Review progress photos |
| Shipping and delivery | About 5–10 business days | Track your parcel |
| Try-on and any small alteration | 3–5 days buffer | Try with your shoes and jewellery |
| **Order by** | **At least 3–4 weeks before the event** | Earlier in peak wedding season |

Indian wedding season runs roughly from November to February, and many families are ordering at the same time. If you have several outfits to buy, start even earlier.

## How to measure yourself correctly

Accurate measurements are the single biggest factor in a good fit. Use a soft measuring tape, wear the bra you plan to wear with the outfit, and ask a friend to help if you can.

- **Bust:** around the fullest part of your chest, tape level across your back.
- **Waist:** around your natural waist, the narrowest part of your torso.
- **Hip:** around the fullest part of your hips and seat.
- **Height:** standing straight without shoes, then tell us the heel height you plan to wear.

Keep the tape snug but not tight, and send your body measurements, not the measurements of a garment you own. Our step-by-step guide on [how to measure](/blog/how-to-measure-yourself-for-a-custom-kurta-set/) has more detail if this is your first time.

Simple, structured designs are the most forgiving for a first custom order. A straight kurta set like the [Grey Hand Block Print Cotton Kurta Set with Kota Doria Dupatta](/products/grey-hand-block-print-cotton-kurta-pant-kota-doria-dupatta-set/) is an easy place to start.

## Customs, duties and delivery

Customs duty, if any, is set by your country, not by the seller, and is paid on delivery. Rules and thresholds differ between the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia, and they can change, so check your local customs website if you want to know the likely amount in advance.

A few practical tips:

- Make sure your name, address and phone number are complete so the courier can contact you.
- Be available to receive the parcel, especially if a duty payment is due.
- Keep your order confirmation handy in case customs asks for it.

## What if the fit is not right?

Even with careful measuring, things happen. Here is how it is handled. If we stitched it wrong, we remake it for free. If your measurements were off, you get one free alteration with up to $10 credit towards a local tailor.

This is one more reason to order early. A buffer of a few days before your event means any fix can happen calmly.

For an evening function, a made-to-measure Anarkali is where custom fit really shines, because the bodice and length matter so much. The [Royal Blue Georgette Anarkali Suit with Gota Lace Dupatta](/products/royal-blue-georgette-anarkali-suit-gota-handwork-dupatta/) is a good example.

For day events, the [Mint Green Hand Block Print Kurta Pant Dupatta Set](/products/mint-green-hand-block-print-cotton-kurta-pant-dupatta-set-with-hand-work-yoke/) is light and easy to wear.

## Frequently asked questions

**How long does a custom stitched Indian outfit take to arrive?**
Stitching takes 5–7 working days and delivery about 5–10 business days. Order at least three to four weeks before your event.

**Which measurements do I need to send?**
Bust, waist, hip and height. You can also add notes about kurta length, sleeve length and heel height.

**Will I have to pay customs duty?**
Possibly. Any duty is set by your country and paid on delivery, so check your local customs rules if you want an estimate.

**What happens if the outfit does not fit?**
If the stitching is wrong, it is remade for free. If the measurements sent were off, you get one free alteration with up to $10 local tailor credit.
